title: Patch: rarity-weighted token bars on a gamified top-of-screen HUD, animated chase cosmetics, a 2% global cosmetic roll, cosmetic tokens spent in place
thread:
**Issue #1953 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1953: Patch: rarity-weighted token bars on a gamified top-of-screen HUD, animated chase cosmetics, a 2% global cosmetic roll, cosmetic tokens spent in place
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

The owner's next cosmetics and economy pass, six changes. It follows #1651's glow-up (#1658's bars, #1661's global roll, #1662's per-card cosmetics). It is server and web work plus SPEC §14. It changes no card data, so it takes no version.

### 1. Token bars fill by rarity, and each holds 200 (SPEC §14.5, R1305000)

Today a spent duplicate adds `CARD_TOKEN_BAR_POINTS_PER_DUPLICATE` = 1 and `COSMETIC_TOKEN_BAR_POINTS_PER_DUPLICATE` = 1 (`crates/server/src/config.rs`), and both bars hold 150. After this change:

- A spent duplicate adds points by the **rarity its slot rolled**: Common **1**, Rare **2**, Epic **3**, Legendary **5**, Mythic **10**. That is the card rarity for a card pack slot. For a cosmetic pack slot with nothing left unowned (R1306001, "gives bar points, as a spent duplicate does"), it is that slot's cosmetic rarity.
- The same points go to **both** bars.
- `CARD_TOKEN_BAR_SIZE` and `COSMETIC_TOKEN_BAR_SIZE` go to **200**.
- The two `*_POINTS_PER_DUPLICATE` constants become named per-rarity tables (CLAUDE.md rule 9). Card rarity and cosmetic rarity are separate types (R1333000), so a table keyed by each type, or one function per type, works. Every table is exported to `apps/web/src/wire/serverConfig.ts` by `crates/server/tests/export_config.rs`.
- Points are counted in `settle_bars` (`crates/server/src/economy/packs.rs`) and the cosmetic pack's fallback path (`economy/cosmetic_packs.rs`). Both now sum per spent slot instead of `spent * 1`, so `spent` has to carry each slot's rarity.
- `economy/math.rs`'s `bar_points_fill_bars_at_target_packs` asserts `points × PACK_SLOTS × target = size`. That is no longer exact. Replace it with an expected-value check: the mean points per pack under `CARD_TIER_WEIGHTS` with the floored slot (about 4 × 1.61 + 2.21 ≈ 8.65) fills 200 in about 23 packs. Set `CARD_TOKEN_BAR_TARGET_PACKS` and `COSMETIC_TOKEN_BAR_TARGET_PACKS` to what that computes, and keep the §14.5 wording ("fills once every … packs on average") true.
- Bars that already hold points keep them. `settle_bar` pays for every size it holds, so nothing needs migrating.

### 2. The token bars become a gamified HUD at the top of the screen

Today the bars draw inside the pack opening (`apps/web/src/economy/OpeningBars.tsx`, `FillBar.tsx`, `RewardReveal.tsx`) and in the shop's `TokenPicker`. They should be **far** more enticing:

- **Top of the screen.** During a pack opening (card packs and cosmetic packs) both bars sit pinned at the top of the viewport.
- **Points fly into the bar.** Each spent duplicate launches its points, labelled ("+5") and tinted by rarity, from the card or slot that earned them into its bar. The bar fills as they land, and bigger rarities get a bigger burst.
- **A full bar pulses.** When a bar fills, it pulses and glows, then plays the existing reward reveal, then carries its overflow over.
- **The server decides** (CLAUDE.md rule 7). Every number on screen comes from the opening's answer (`OpeningBarsAnswer`). Add per-slot points to that answer if the client needs them to aim each flight, and never compute them client-side.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` and the animation settings the rest of the client honours: no flights or pulses, just the final fill.

### 3. Legendary and Mythic cosmetics are animated

Every Legendary and Mythic **playmat (`table`), card back, foil, finish and border** in `crates/server/cosmetics.json` gets a looping animation that reads as premium. Today that is 17 entries:

- foils `foil-cracked-ice`, `foil-molten-gold`, `foil-void-shimmer`
- finishes `finish-gilded-edge`, `finish-obsidian`, `finish-starlit`
- borders `border-filigree`, `border-celestial`
- tables `table-obsidian-slab`, `table-ancient-map`, `table-astral`
- card backs `card-back-dragon-scale`, `card-back-clockwork`, `card-back-nebula`
- fields `field-aurora`, `field-lightning-storm`, `field-cosmic-drift`

The owner's rule: **animate it, or drop its rarity.** Any of these the builder cannot animate well goes down to Epic in the registry. That has knock-ons the registry check enforces: the chase mark is set exactly on Legendary and Mythic (R1333000), and account cosmetics stay Epic or better (R1661000). Say in the pull request which entries, if any, were dropped. The two starter chases (`foil-cracked-ice`, `finish-gilded-edge`) should stay Legendary and be animated.

- Animations are CSS or canvas-free where possible, so a board full of animated foils stays cheap.
- They respect reduced motion and the client's animation and effects settings.
- They draw everywhere the cosmetic is drawn: in game, on card faces, in the collection, previews and tiles.
- Fields are not on the owner's list but sit beside the playmats in the same tiles. Animate them the same way for consistency, or leave them and say so.

### 4. Global cosmetic drop chance: 10% → 2% (R1661001)

`GLOBAL_COSMETIC_ROLL_WEIGHT` goes from 100 to **20** (out of `TIER_WEIGHT_TOTAL` = 1000). Update the constant's doc comment ("#1661: 10%"), SPEC §14.3, and the odds on `/purchases`, which come from the server.

### 5. Remove "Defaults for every card"

Remove the **Defaults for every card** section of the Collection's Cosmetics tab (`apps/web/src/routes/collection.tsx` → `CardCosmeticsControls` in `apps/web/src/collection/CosmeticsPanel.tsx`) and its zh-CN string. The owner will bring it back later in a new form.

- With no way left to change the account-wide foil, finish and border pick, a card with no pick of its own **wears its kind's default**. It no longer falls back to the account's stored pick. Otherwise an invisible, unchangeable setting would still dress players' cards.
- Do not delete the `cosmetics` settings group's keys: R1655000 freezes its shape so old and new clients don't overwrite each other.
- The Full-art cards setting is a setting, not part of that section, so it stays.
- Update R1655000's "The fallback" paragraph, and the tests that render `CardCosmeticsControls` (`cards/accountOwnership.test.tsx`, `cards/cosmetics.test.tsx`).

### 6. Cosmetic tokens are spent where you preview or change a cosmetic, not in the shop

- Remove the cosmetic token picker from the shop (`apps/web/src/shop/TokenPicker.tsx`). The **card** token picker and both bars' readouts stay.
- A held Rare or Epic cosmetic token is offered **on the spot** wherever a cosmetic you don't own is shown locked and could otherwise be equipped:
  - the card's own cosmetics view (`collection/CardCosmeticsView.tsx`) for a card's foil, finish, border and full art;
  - the playmat, backdrop and card back tiles (`collection/AccountCosmeticTiles.tsx`, and the deck builder's pickers if they show locked entries);
  - anywhere else a card's cosmetics can be previewed or changed.
- The offer reads like "Unlock with an Epic token (2 held)". It shows only when a held token's tier covers the cosmetic: a Rare token covers Common and Rare, an Epic token covers Epic and below, and no token covers a chase (R1305003). It calls the existing `POST /api/tokens/redeem-cosmetic` and re-reads ownership. A refusal shows the server's words and changes nothing.
- No server change is needed for this part.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Server unit tests: a card pack whose spent duplicates rolled Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary and Mythic adds 1 + 2 + 3 + 5 + 10 = 21 to each bar. A bar at 195 that gains 10 pays once and keeps 5. A cosmetic pack slot with nothing unowned adds its rolled cosmetic rarity's points.
- [ ] `CARD_TOKEN_BAR_SIZE` = `COSMETIC_TOKEN_BAR_SIZE` = 200, the per-rarity points tables and `GLOBAL_COSMETIC_ROLL_WEIGHT` = 20 are named constants, exported to `serverConfig.ts` (diff committed). `economy/math.rs`'s bar test checks the expected-value fill against the new target packs.
- [ ] SPEC §14.3 and §14.5 and the constants table updated. A new ruling note in this issue's block (CLAUDE.md rule 3) records rarity-weighted bar points and the 2% roll, with a proving test named after it. R1655000 and R1661001 amended. `cargo jackioh spec check` is green.
- [ ] Web tests: the opening HUD renders both bars at the top, plays one flight per spent duplicate with the server's points, pulses on a fill, and skips flights and pulses under reduced motion.
- [ ] Every Legendary and Mythic foil, finish, border, table, card back (and field, unless the PR says why not) in the registry either has an animation class the client applies, checked by a test that walks the registry, or has been dropped to Epic with the registry check still green.
- [ ] The Collection's Cosmetics tab has no "Defaults for every card" section. A card with no own pick draws its kind's default even when the synced settings hold a non-default foil, finish or border.
- [ ] The shop shows no cosmetic token picker. `CardCosmeticsView` and the account tiles offer a held, eligible token on a locked cosmetic, redeem it through the API, and show it owned afterwards. A chase never shows the offer.
- [ ] The five required checks are green, and `ui-walkthrough` screenshots of the opening HUD and an animated Mythic foil are attached to the pull request.

## Blocked by, part of

Nothing. It follows #1651, #1658, #1661 and #1662.
```
